```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Convert StichtagDat to datetime for easier date manipulation
data['StichtagDat'] = pd.to_datetime(data['StichtagDat'])

# Create a histogram of age groups
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.histplot(data['AlterVHundNum'], bins=10, kde=True)
plt.title('Age Distribution of Registered Dogs')
plt.xlabel('Age (Years)')
plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs')
plt.xticks(range(0, 11))
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
